description: settings.json as both servers normalise it (normalizeGuiSettings in server/src/config/gui-settings.ts, SettingsStore in roamgate-base): every section, valid and invalid values, older shapes. The result's key order is the file's. Read by `bun test` in server/src/config/gui-settings.vectors.test.ts.
